BiblicalUsage: Ephai the Netophathite was a captain who came with his men to Gedaliah at Mizpah, after the Babylonians had taken Jerusalem. He came to Mizpah with his men after the fall of Jerusalem, to submit to Gedaliah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ephai is one of the captains who came to Gedaliah after the fall of Jerusalem, and his name is all that is left of him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
